name: Renewing
overview: Scripture reveals that renewing is a vital spiritual process involving God's transformative power. Isaiah 40:31 illustrates that those who wait on the Lord will have their strength renewed, enabling them to persevere without weariness. Romans 12:2 emphasizes the renewing of the mind as essential for believers to be transformed and discern God's perfect will. This renewal is not by human effort but by God's mercy and the renewing work of the Holy Spirit, as Titus 3:5 teaches, calling believers to present themselves as living sacrifices in response to God's grace (Romans 12:1).
